title: Otori Emu — Clear-Eyed To The Future〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Morinomiya Revue - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Everyone from the crowd is basically gone now. When did that happen?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We have been talking for quite a while now about how great the new Kikyogumi is...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I really appreciate you all telling me what you thought. It's always nice to hear directly from the audience like this.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: This is just the start of a new journey, but I plan to continue down this path with confidence and turn our idea into the correct solution.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Nod*
We'll be rooting for you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, Emu, you helped come up with this idea, right? You've only told us bits and pieces until now. Can you tell us more about how you contributed?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: How I contributed?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, since you did just pull off something rather spectacular. I'd also like to hear more about what you did.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Me as well.
This has everything to do with management, so I'm sure that it wasn't easy.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, it wasn't...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
It was really challenging.
No matter how hard I tried, I struggled to come up with good ideas.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Especially since saving Kikyogumi from being disbanded meant coming up with an idea that didn't hurt their revenue or the quality of their performances.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: But none of this would have been possible without Otori's help.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, you did all the work in terms of making it actually possible! I never would've been able to do that all by myself.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I see.
In other words, you both contributed equally to this idea.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And you presented it to the board, Byakkomachi?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Yes, Otori and I did.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Together...?
Wait, Emu, you were also there?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! I helped present our idea to the board!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu? Giving a big presentation...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I have to think it went like...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Dun da-da-dun! Everybody, eyes on me!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Today's presentation is going to be so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because I came up with an idea that's gonna make everybody smile from ear to ear!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I'm sure it'll make the entire board smile in the same way!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Upbeat and cheerful is what comes to mind.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: S-Same...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Was there any trouble...?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: She was visibly nervous before we got started, but she ended up doing an incredibly good job.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: She presented all of the key points in a very digestible and dignified manner.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Digestible and dignified...?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: But she also did a good job of making an emotional appeal. The board responded very well to that.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: She got them to hear her out and think about our idea seriously, and moved their hearts in a fairly obvious way.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu? Giving a moving speech...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Everyone! What Kikyogumi needs to worry about the most right now is being wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They should be putting on wonderhoy performances that make everyone feel really wonderhoy...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: As long as they do that, then I'm sure this plan will end up succeeding!

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: Wonderhoy... Yes, I'd forgotten all about that sensation...

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: Me too. We used to be all about making people feel wonderhoy.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Then, so that you don't forget again...
Let's all remind ourselves what it really means to feel wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ready?! One, two, three!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Board Members
rows.Line: Wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I-I see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I have a feeling that what really happened is starkly different from what we're imagining.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Way different. There's no way we're right.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What's wrong, you guys?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, sorry.
We just don't seem to have the imagination necessary to accurately predict what actually happened...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. But the fact that you actually convinced the board with your presentation is really amazing...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Actually, I have to thank my brothers for that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Your brothers?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! I wanted to give a moving presentation that made our intentions clear.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, I asked them to train me!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. We had no idea.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
I knew that I had to learn how to sooner or later... And I practiced giving it a bunch of times.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see. You really did your best, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Nod*
It's still hard to imagine how you actually pulled this off, but the results you achieved speak for themselves.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree. I'm also glad that your hard work ended up paying off, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Nice work, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks, you guys...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm gonna work even harder moving forward... To learn more about management, and get better at giving presentations too!
